'''Ralf Blobelt Home One Mains''' is a [[Light]] deck by [[Ralf Blobelt]], published on [[Trandosite]].<ref name="trandosite">[http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com/ls129.htm Home One Mains], [[Trandosite]] ([[Rod Latham]]). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010426032532/http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com:80/ls129.htm Internet Archive]</ref>

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Ralf Blobelt]]
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]] (from the card pool)
* '''Published:''' [[Trandosite]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Strategy:''' Mains And Toys
